notice: Pre-registered before any Sprint 11 implementation commit. Cases, gold expectations, arms, rubric and thresholds are fixed here. Later changes are appended to `amendments` with a date and reason, and earlier results are kept. Brand and territory names are evaluation inputs only: nothing under backend/src reads this file (AGENTS.md generalization rule 2). DEVELOPMENT cases may be used for tuning; HOLDOUT cases may not, and none of their brands appears anywhere else in the repository at registration time.

A.policy: production research policy at main c8f3633 (no research brief, no concept alignment, mandatory reference construction for analyze_move, findings-only synthesis)

B.policy: Sprint 11 research-intelligence policy (research brief, concept alignment at anchoring, intent-judged exemplars, agent-chosen research approach, two-layer synthesis)

arms.controls: Both arms use claude-haiku-5-5 at the production effort, the same tools, the same global budgets (no ceiling is raised), the same Qloo answers (calls shared by both arms are served from the case's recording), and the same brand-context packet when one is listed.

goldSemantics.conceptGold: For each requested concept: what the user means (`meaning`) and nearby concepts that are NOT equivalent (`notEquivalent`). A run fails `conceptIntegrity` if it presents a concept matching a `notEquivalent` description as equivalent coverage of the user's concept, without qualification.
goldSemantics.approachGold: `acceptableApproaches` lists research approaches a competent strategist could defend. An approach outside the list is not an automatic failure; the blinded rater decides whether it was justified.
goldSemantics.abstentionGold: `abstention`: REQUIRED (the correct answer is that the direction is not supportable or not a cultural question), ACCEPTABLE (an honest inconclusive answer is fine), WRONG (strong Qloo coverage is expected; abstaining without evidence of absence is a judgment failure).
goldSemantics.brandCoreGold: `brandCore`: true when the requested concept is the brand's established business category. Such a result must be framed as established positioning, never as a stretch or a last-place opportunity.

rubric.scale: 0 = fails, 1 = partially, 2 = fully. Rated per run by a blinded human; runs of one case are shown as X/Y in a seeded random order with arm, model and policy fields removed.

dimensions.intentFidelity: Did the investigation answer the user's actual question, with the meaning the user intended?
dimensions.culturalUnderstanding: Were the concepts and exemplars meaningful instances of the intended cultural phenomenon?
dimensions.researchJudgment: Were the chosen evidence paths productive, and was effort spent where it could change the answer?
dimensions.strategicUsefulness: Would the conclusion help someone make a better research or business decision?
dimensions.discoveryQuality: Open-discovery cases only: were non-obvious directions relevant and grounded?

deterministic.evidenceIntegrity: 0 fabricated Qloo ids/tags/affinities; every number traces to a deterministic result; claim validation passed or replaced by the template.
deterministic.unsupportedClassification: 0 classifications outside a FULL relative route.
deterministic.conceptIntegrity: 0 runs presenting a concept matching a gold `notEquivalent` description as EQUIVALENT (graded from the result's conceptAlignment and summary by the rater with the gold sheet visible AFTER blinded scoring).
deterministic.brandCoreFraming: brandCore cases: the result carries the brand-core limitation and never a stretch class without it.
deterministic.efficiency: Qloo calls and model USD per run; useful finding = a run rated ≥ 1 on strategicUsefulness.

hardGates: no regression in pnpm test, test:durable, eval:agent, eval:query, eval:methodology
thresholds.improvement: Holdouts only, paired per case. Improvement is demonstrated when, for BOTH intentFidelity and strategicUsefulness, B wins more cases than A with a net margin ≥ 4 (wins − losses) and a one-sided sign test p < 0.10 over non-tied cases. A tie or a smaller margin is reported as NOT_DEMONSTRATED. Results below n = 16 rated holdouts are reported as INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.
thresholds.efficiency: Median Qloo calls per holdout run for B ≤ 1.25 × A, and Qloo calls per useful finding for B ≤ A.
thresholds.interpretationTier: Live Haiku interpretation only (no Qloo), B arm: the research brief names every gold concept separately for compound cases (h06, h07, d2) and states a notEquivalent distinction or ambiguity for ≥ 3 of the 4 near-match/ambiguous holdouts (h08, h09, h10, h18). Reported as LIVE_HAIKU_INTERPRETATION, never as agent validation.

tiers.T0: Offline, provider-free, in CI: contract and runtime-rule tests on synthetic fixtures. Never research-quality evidence.
tiers.T1: Live Haiku interpretation only over development + holdout queries. Needs explicit spending approval.
tiers.T2: Live Qloo + Haiku paired A/B over the 18 holdouts (36 runs, shared recordings). Needs explicit spending approval.
tiers.T3: Blinded human rating of T2 outputs (owner). Not independent of the project: reported as owner rating.
